history.majorEvents: Secundum atrial septal defect surgical repair 1997 (Children’s National). Tonsillectomy and adenoidectomy 2002. Last generalized tonic-clonic seizure 03/2026; averages 1-2 per year.
history.ongoingProblems: Down syndrome; moderate intellectual disability; epilepsy; hypothyroidism; obstructive sleep apnea on CPAP; obesity.
history.preventiveCare: Hepatitis B vaccine series completed 2010 (3 doses); anti-HBs positive 10/20/2026. Influenza vaccine 10/2026. PPD placed 10/20/2026, read 10/22/2026: 0 mm induration, negative. Annual audiology and ophthalmology recommended.
history.social: Lives with mother and court-appointed legal guardian Loretta Jenkins (age 68). Attends day habilitation program 5 days/week. Mother has worsening health and can no longer provide 24-hour supervision; family requesting ICF/IID placement through DDA. Denies tobacco, alcohol and drug use. Not sexually active. Environmental concern: wanders, poor safety awareness, needs supervision near traffic and stove.
history.developmental: Down syndrome (trisomy 21) diagnosed at birth by karyotype. Global developmental delay noted in infancy: walked at 30 months, first words at age 3. Psychological evaluation (WISC-IV) 2008 at age 12: Full Scale IQ 48. Repeat WAIS-IV 2015 at age 19: FSIQ 51, moderate intellectual disability. Special education through age 21 (DCPS certificate of completion 2017).

encounters.chiefComplaint: Annual physical / pre-admission H&P for ICF/IID placement
encounters.subjective:
30 y/o M with Down syndrome, moderate intellectual disability and epilepsy, accompanied by mother/guardian. Here for annual physical and paperwork for DDA ICF/IID placement.
Last seizure 03/2026 (generalized tonic-clonic, ~2 minutes). Adherent to levetiracetam with mother administering. Uses CPAP nightly. No recent illness, hospitalizations or ER visits in past year.
Function: needs verbal cues and supervision for bathing, dressing and hygiene. Cannot manage money, medications, cooking or travel independently. Speaks in 2-3 word phrases. Poor safety awareness; has wandered from home twice this year.
encounters.objective:
Gen: short stature, features of trisomy 21 (upslanting palpebral fissures, flat nasal bridge, single palmar crease). Cooperative.
HEENT: epicanthal folds, Brushfield spots, macroglossia, dentition fair. Neck: supple, thyroid not enlarged.
Chest: clear to auscultation. CV: RRR, no murmur, well-healed sternotomy scar. Abdomen: obese, soft, non-tender, no masses.
GU: normal male, testes descended bilaterally. Prostate exam not done. Skin: dry skin, mild xerosis of hands. Extremities: no edema, pes planus. Lymph: no adenopathy.
Neuro: CN II-XII grossly intact, mild generalized hypotonia, broad-based but steady gait, strength 5/5 throughout.
Labs 10/20/2026: CBC normal (WBC 5.8, Hgb 14.1, Plt 210). CMP normal (Cr 0.9, ALT 22). TSH 2.8. Levetiracetam level 18 mcg/mL (therapeutic). Lipids: TC 188, LDL 112, HDL 44, TG 160. HbA1c 5.6%. HBsAg negative, anti-HBs positive. RPR non-reactive. UA normal.
PPD placed 10/20/2026, read 10/22/2026: 0 mm, negative.
encounters.assessment:
Down syndrome (Q90.9) with moderate intellectual disability (F71), onset before age 22.
Epilepsy, controlled (G40.909).
Hypothyroidism, euthyroid on replacement (E03.9).
OSA on CPAP (G47.33). Obesity, BMI 35 (E66.9).
Requires ICF/IID level of care: 24-hour supervision, active treatment, assistance with self-care, self-direction, capacity for independent living, and health and safety.
encounters.plan:
Continue levetiracetam 750 mg BID, levothyroxine 100 mcg daily, vitamin D.
Recommended clinical services: speech and language therapy, occupational therapy, nutrition (weight management), fitness training.
TSH every 6 months; annual audiology and ophthalmology; CPAP nightly; seizure precautions; supervision near water, traffic and stove.
DDS Medical Evaluation form and ICF/IID physician certification to be completed.
